mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently 59 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a Waxing Crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
Looking at city updates, there are no new emails or urgent city notices currently on the desk for this morning.

There is plenty to do around town! Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, and trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to ART House 360 events and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co.
In a noteworthy call from October 9, a two-vehicle crash on USH 18/151 resulted in a driver being transported to the hospital with minor injuries after a lane deviation incident.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently closed, but they will open today at 10:00 AM so you can swing by and grab a treat.
